prompts.shell: Single isolated pixel-art game sprite for a MapleStory-like side-scrolling RPG: one Geo Hypostasis outer shell cube inspired by Genshin Impact. Three-quarter view, three visible faces, heavy dark ochre stone panels, engraved square maze motifs with bright amber-gold channels, a few crisp pale golden highlights. Chunky handcrafted pixel clusters, hard stepped outlines, limited earthy palette, readable at 64 pixels high. Single cube only, no core, no other cubes, no lettering, no ground shadow, no particles, no blur. Center with generous transparent margins. True transparent background. A usable in-game sprite, not a smooth 3D render.
prompts.core: One isolated pixel-art sprite: Geo Hypostasis exposed core inspired by Genshin Impact, for a MapleStory-like side scrolling RPG. A single floating amber golden octahedral crystal, diamond silhouette, faceted triangular planes, pale yellow central light, dark burnt-orange outline, golden lower planes. Chunky pixel clusters, crisp stair-step silhouette, limited palette, readable at 64 pixels high. Generous clear margins, truly transparent background. No cubes, no shell, no text, no particle cloud, no ground, no shadow, no soft halo or blur. In-game pixel sprite, not smooth rendered gemstone.
prompts.pillar: Single isolated pixel-art sprite of a tall Geo Hypostasis stone pillar inspired by Genshin Impact, for a MapleStory-like 2D side-scroller. Straight vertical square stone column, about three times taller than wide, narrow stepped cap and base, dark brown and ochre rock blocks, an amber glowing angular rune running up the front. Slight three-quarter view to show a narrow side face, strong flat ground-contact base. Crisp hard-edged chunky pixels, 16-24 earthy colors, readable at 128px height. Entire pillar visible with generous margins, no floating core or cubes, no landscape, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no words. Truly transparent background. No soft bloom, no blur. Reusable game sprite.
